entries.title: Job 26:2
segments: How hast thou helped him that is without power! How hast thou saved the arm that hath no strength!

entries.title: Job 26:3
segments: How hast thou counselled him that hath no wisdom, And plentifully declared sound knowledge!

entries.title: Job 26:4
segments: To whom hast thou uttered words? And whose spirit came forth from thee?

entries.title: Job 26:5
segments: They that are deceased tremble Beneath the waters and the inhabitants thereof.

entries.title: Job 26:6
segments: Sheol is naked before [God], And Abaddon hath no covering.

entries.title: Job 26:7
segments: He stretcheth out the north over empty space, And hangeth the earth upon nothing.

entries.title: Job 26:8
segments: He bindeth up the waters in his thick clouds; And the cloud is not rent under them.

entries.title: Job 26:9
segments: He incloseth the face of his throne, And spreadeth his cloud upon it.

entries.title: Job 26:10
segments: He hath described a boundary upon the face of the waters, Unto the confines of light and darkness.

entries.title: Job 26:11
segments: The pillars of heaven tremble And are astonished at his rebuke.

entries.title: Job 26:12
segments: He stirreth up the sea with his power, And by his understanding he smiteth through Rahab.

entries.title: Job 26:13
segments: By his Spirit the heavens are garnished; His hand hath pierced the swift serpent.

entries.title: Job 26:14
segments: Lo, these are but the outskirts of his ways: And how small a whisper do we hear of him! But the thunder of his power who can understand?
